summary: Avoid redundant science-route construction and material scans; stop idle Library translation maintenance.
details: Prepare route comparison sets and ranking keys once, filter strict supersets by cardinality in the existing prerequisite-then-science order, and retain the original final-sort tie behavior.

Prove initial recipes in lexical winner order before constructing research-dependent alternatives. Retain direct-source precedence and contextual feasibility. Initial-priority provenance explicitly marks alternative selection counts incomplete; bounded rejection diagnostics retain exhaustive traversal.

Select material-return facts through Context-owned typed consumer and producer buckets, preserving hidden and zero-result facts, variants and native transitions. Unowned or malformed indexes use the established exact scan fallback.

Subscribe Library translation maintenance only while issued callbacks remain pending, and reconstruct the subscription read-only after loading. Settled closed or never-opened views retain no translation-maintenance timer.

Controlled Lua 5.2 checks cover complete selector records, staged filtering, duplicates, ties, copy isolation, initial precedence, indexed membership and Library subscription lifecycle. Native Galore startup and final package/save/client acceptance remain pending; no player speedup is claimed by these controls.
